name: Li Mei reported Mileena wielding a destructive talisman
notes: Mortal Kombat X Story Mode has Li Mei report that Mileena's rebels possess a gold talisman with a center jewel whose crimson energy has erased entire battalions and shifted the Outworld conflict. This Fact preserves the report as reported evidence; it does not by itself assert that the talisman's identity has already been verified as Shinnok's amulet.
